chunks: From Yunus ibn Ribat, he said:
I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) saying: Verily, the people of truth have always been in hardship; indeed, that is for a short period and [followed by] long-lasting well-being.

key_terms.عَافِيَةٍ: Well-being, safety, or deliverance from harm

ai.seo_question: What is the duration of the believers' hardship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) states that the believers (people of truth) have historically endured difficulties and hardships. However, this period of affliction is temporary and short, leading to a prolonged state of well-being and ease.
